SELECT TT.* FROM (SELECT FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID,FE.EMPLOYEE_CODE,FE.NAME, FOU.UNIT_ID,FOU.UNIT_NAME,FOP.POSITION_ID,FOP.POSITION_NAME, FEA.COMPANY_ID, CASE WHEN FEA.COMPANY_ID = 261 THEN '光大幸福国际租赁有限公司' ELSE '光大幸福商业保理有限公司' END COMPANY_NAME FROM FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE FE ON FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID = FE.EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FEA.UNIT_ID = FOU.UNIT_ID LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_POSITION FOP ON FEA.POSITION_ID = FOP.POSITION_ID) TT WHERE TT.EMPLOYEE_CODE is not null AND TT.UNIT_ID is not null AND TT.POSITION_ID is not null
AND TT.EMPLOYEE_CODE LIKE concat(concat('%',#{employeeCode}),'%')
AND TT.COMPANY_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{companyName}),'%')
AND TT.NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{name}),'%')
ORDER BY TT.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID ASC
